stages.label: Germination & crown root
stages.description: Seedlings emerge; the first irrigation at crown-root initiation (~21 days) is critical.

stages.label: Tillering & jointing
stages.description: Tillers form and the stem elongates; top-dress nitrogen with irrigation.

stages.label: Heading & grain filling
stages.description: Ears emerge and grains fill; heat above 32 °C now shrivels the grain.

stages.label: Ripening
stages.description: Grain hardens; stop irrigation and harvest when golden.

events.title: Sowing Wheat
events.detail: Seedlings emerge; the first irrigation at crown-root initiation (~21 days) is critical. Expected harvest around 27 Mar.
events.action: Apply the basal dose (full P and K, one-third of N) at sowing.

events.title: Tillering & jointing
events.detail: Tillers form and the stem elongates; top-dress nitrogen with irrigation.

events.title: Nitrogen top-dressing
events.detail: The crop's nitrogen demand rises sharply as it starts rapid growth.
events.action: Top-dress urea just before an irrigation so it moves into the root zone.

events.title: Yellow rust risk
events.detail: Recent weather favours yellow rust at this stage.
events.action: Scout for yellow stripes on leaves; spray propiconazole 25 EC @ 1 ml/L at first sign.

events.title: Heading & grain filling
events.detail: Ears emerge and grains fill; heat above 32 °C now shrivels the grain.

events.title: Wheat aphid risk
events.detail: Recent weather favours wheat aphid at this stage.
events.action: Spray only above 10 aphids per tiller; conserve ladybird beetles.

events.title: Irrigation — about 222 mm
events.detail: Root-zone moisture fell to 32% of available water, the point where this crop starts to suffer.

events.title: Heat stress — up to 35°C
events.detail: Temperatures above 32°C during grain filling reduce grain weight.
events.action: Give a light evening irrigation to cool the canopy.

events.action: Give a light evening irrigation to cool the canopy.

events.title: Harvest Wheat
events.detail: Expected yield about 16.0 quintal per acre.
events.action: Harvest at physiological maturity and dry the produce before storage.

factors.label: Water stewardship
factors.note: Needs about 222 mm of pumped irrigation this season.

factors.label: Soil nitrogen
factors.note: Depends on applied nitrogen; split doses and neem-coated urea cut losses.

factors.label: Crop rotation
factors.note: Tell us the previous crop to score the rotation.

factors.label: Residue management
factors.note: Residue is often burnt in this crop — use a Happy Seeder or in-situ decomposer instead.

factors.label: Climate resilience
factors.note: Moderately sensitive to weather extremes; manage stress stages carefully.
